label: Pregnant woman controlled by her partner (19 Nov 2026)
group_title: Pregnant woman hypnotized / controlled by her partner, 19 Nov 2026
description: Worldwide sweep, 19 Nov 2026, for titles in which a pregnant adult woman is hypnotized, entranced or mind-controlled by her partner (husband, boyfriend, fiancé, lover, the baby's father or an ex), or in which the partner engages a hypnotist for her. Searched the web, X, TikTok and Instagram (social posts used only as leads). Existing titles gain only missing categories and fields under the usual merge rules. Adults only; non-explicit notes; stories centered on a hypnotized woman being used for sex are not added. This file is appended at the true end of SOURCES so existing IDs do not shift.

records.title: Virrudh
records.provenance: Deep refresh, 19 Nov 2026 PT — pregnant woman controlled by her partner (adults only; non-explicit notes)
records.meta: Hindi soap opera · India · Sony TV · 26 Mar 2007 – 17 Jan 2008 · Ugraya Entertainment / Applause Entertainment · starring Smriti Irani · also spelled Viruddh
records.character: Shreya (Dhirendra Raisinghania's daughter, married to Siddharth)
records.summary: Shreya marries Siddharth against her sister Vasudha's wishes, not knowing that he is already married to Naina (Natasha). Siddharth hypnotizes Shreya and makes her shoot her father, Dhirendra, who dies. Later, while pregnant, Shreya learns the truth about Siddharth and vows revenge. A recording of her confession, made by another hypnotist, is later used for blackmail.
records.pregnant_end_note: The source describes Shreya as pregnant after the hypnosis storyline, when she learns the truth. The birth outcome isn't stated.
records.pregnancy_note: Pregnant during the revenge arc, presumably by her husband Siddharth; the source doesn't state the father or the outcome.
records.kids_together_note: The source doesn't say whether the child is born.
records.kids_note: No children before this marriage are mentioned.
records.evidence: India Forums recap: 'Shreya is hypnotised by her hubby Siddharth and he makes her shoot her Dad'; later 'Shreya is pregnant, comes to know the truth behind Siddharth and vows to get revenge.' Wikipedia confirms the series, its channel and its run.
records.confidence_flag: Medium · 2 sources (plot detail from a fan recap)
